content.short: Squid enables single-click cross-chain swaps and contract calls across multiple chains.
content.description: Squid enables developers to add single-click cross-chain swaps and purchases across networks by leveraging cross-chain infrastructure. It provides a JavaScript SDK, API, and a front-end widget to integrate cross-chain functionality into any app. Developers can enable cross-chain staking, NFT purchases, and payments, while users swap tokens across chains in a single click from the app's front end. Supported across networks, Squid aims to streamline cross-chain interactions for developers and users alike.
